```{r setup, message=FALSE, warning=FALSE}
library(readr)
library(dplyr)
library(here)

here::i_am('scripts/s2_selecting_pink_variables.Rmd')

data_path <- here("data/general/nuMoM2b_Merged_Dataset.csv")
out_dir   <- here("outputs/s2")
dir.create(out_dir, recursive = TRUE, showWarnings = FALSE)
```

```{r load-data}
# ---- Load full dataset (all columns) ----
all_cols <- names(read_csv(data_path, n_max = 0, show_col_types = FALSE))

id_col <- "PublicID"
if (!(id_col %in% all_cols)) stop("PublicID column not found in dataset.")

# Check CMAE14 exists
if (!("CMAE14" %in% all_cols)) stop("CMAE14 column not found in dataset.")

# Check which pink vars are present
present <- intersect(pink_vars, all_cols)
missing <- setdiff(pink_vars, all_cols)

message("Pink variables found in dataset:     ", length(present))
message("Pink variables NOT found in dataset: ", length(missing))

if (length(missing) > 0) {
  message("Missing variables: ", paste(missing, collapse = ", "))
  write_csv(
    tibble(variable = missing),
    file.path(out_dir, "pink_vars_missing_in_dataset.csv")
  )
}

# ---- Read ALL columns (needed for Dataset 1) ----
full_data <- read_csv(data_path, show_col_types = FALSE)

message("Total rows loaded: ", nrow(full_data))
message("Total columns in full dataset: ", ncol(full_data))
```

```{r split-by-cmae14}
# ---- Identify rows where CMAE14 == 1 ----
n_cmae14_1 <- sum(full_data$CMAE14 == 1, na.rm = TRUE)
n_total     <- nrow(full_data)

message("--------------------------------------------------")
message("NOTE: Total rows in dataset:               ", n_total)
message("NOTE: Rows with CMAE14 = 1:                ", n_cmae14_1)
message("NOTE: Rows to be removed from pink dataset: ", n_cmae14_1)
message("NOTE: Rows remaining after removal:        ", n_total - n_cmae14_1)
message("--------------------------------------------------")

# ---- Dataset 1: ALL columns, rows where CMAE14 == 1 ----
cmae14_flagged <- full_data %>%
  filter(CMAE14 == 1)

message("Dataset 1 (all columns, CMAE14 = 1 rows): ",
        nrow(cmae14_flagged), " rows x ", ncol(cmae14_flagged), " cols")

# ---- Dataset 2: pink variables only, excluding rows where CMAE14 == 1 ----
pink_clean <- full_data %>%
  filter(is.na(CMAE14) | CMAE14 != 1) %>%
  select(all_of(c(id_col, present)))

message("Dataset 2 (pink vars, CMAE14=1 rows removed): ",
        nrow(pink_clean), " rows x ", ncol(pink_clean), " cols")
```

```{r save-outputs}
# ---- Save Dataset 1: CMAE14 = 1 flagged rows ----
write_csv(cmae14_flagged, file.path(out_dir, "v1_1_cmae14_flagged_rows.csv"))
saveRDS(cmae14_flagged,   file.path(out_dir, "v1_1_cmae14_flagged_rows.rds"))

message("Saved: outputs/s2/v1_1_cmae14_flagged_rows.csv  (",
        nrow(cmae14_flagged), " rows)")

# ---- Save Dataset 2: clean pink variables ----
write_csv(pink_clean, file.path(out_dir, "v1_2_pink_variables_clean.csv"))
saveRDS(pink_clean,   file.path(out_dir, "v1_2_pink_variables_clean.rds"))

message("Saved: outputs/s2/v1_2_pink_variables_clean.csv  (",
        nrow(pink_clean), " rows)")

# ---- Quick peek ----
message("--- Preview: CMAE14 flagged rows ---")
head(cmae14_flagged %>% select(PublicID, CMAE14))

message("--- Preview: clean pink dataset ---")
head(pink_clean[, 1:min(6, ncol(pink_clean))])
```
